title: UI/UX & Product Design Internship (Web, Mobile & AI Systems)
description:
##### ***Ahmedabad******,*** ***GJ******,*** ***India***

Location

Prahladnagar, Ahmedabad

Work Mode

In-Office (On-Site HQ)

Duration

6 Months or 12 Months

Openings

2 Positions

**About Arihant AI**
--------------------

Arihant AI is an enterprise software and artificial intelligence engineering company based in Ahmedabad. We design, engineer, and deploy Cloud ERP systems, autonomous AI agent platforms, customer portals, and web and mobile applications for manufacturing, logistics, retail, jewellery, and service enterprises across India and globally.

We hold a firm belief that enterprise software should never feel clunky, complex, or outdated. We maintain high standards for clean typography, ergonomic layout architecture, purposeful micro-interactions, and refined visual craft. Our design and creative engineering team sets the visual standard for everything we build.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically curious **UI/UX & Product Design Intern** to join our product and engineering team at our Ahmedabad headquarters. Both **6-month and 12-month** internship tenures are available to accommodate university final-year curriculum and industrial training requirements.

In this role, you will work across the complete product lifecycle: from engaging with clients to understand their operational workflows and business requirements, to building reusable design systems, generating high-impact AI visuals and intro videos, and collaborating directly with engineers to ship production-grade enterprise software.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Client Coordination & Requirement Discovery**

* Participate in client coordination meetings to understand operational workflows, business bottlenecks, and user needs across various industries (manufacturing, supply chain, retail, enterprise services).
* Translate complex client requirements and business logic into intuitive user journeys, wireframes, and interactive interface flows.
* Present design concepts, layout rationale, and user journeys clearly to clients and internal stakeholders, gathering constructive feedback and iterating rapidly.

### **2. Modern UI/UX Design for Web & Mobile Applications**

* Design modern, clean, and ergonomic interfaces for cloud ERP modules, executive dashboards, customer portals, and mobile business apps.
* Develop user flows, information architecture, navigation patterns, and responsive mockups that solve complex enterprise problems with simplicity and clarity.
* Ensure designs adapt seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.

### **3. Scalable Design Systems & Component Architecture**

* Build, document, and maintain unified Design Systems using modern component-driven tooling.
* Establish and govern consistent design tokens: 4px/8px spatial grids, responsive typography scales, semantic color palettes (dark-tech, modern clean enterprise, contrast-compliant), elevation levels, and border radiuses.
* Develop comprehensive component libraries with complete interaction states (default, hover, focus, active, loading, disabled, error).
* Ensure visual cohesion across all digital touchpoints, web modules, and mobile applications.

### **4. Google Stitch & Rapid AI Prototyping**

* Utilize Google Stitch for rapid UI prototyping, automated layout generation, and responsive variant exploration.
* Transform conceptual product briefs and design tokens into semantic Stitch layouts, speeding up the feedback loop between design and development.
* Bridge the gap between design prompts, visual tokens, and production-ready frontend code.

### **5. Generative AI Imagery & Asset Creation**

* Leverage modern Generative AI visual tools and prompt workflows to produce bespoke, high-end visual assets, 3D-styled enterprise visuals, hardware renders, and contextual UI backgrounds.
* Maintain prompt engineering discipline, seed consistency, lighting control, and brand color alignment so that all visual assets feel intentional and cohesive.
* Create and curate vector graphics (SVG), custom iconography sets, product badges, data flow diagrams, and marketing graphics.

### **6. Intro Videos, Motion Design & Product Walkthroughs**

* Storyboard, design, and produce engaging product intro videos, feature launch teasers, and software walkthroughs.
* Explore modern motion workflows, code-driven animations, and AI video generation tools (including agentic frameworks like Antigravity or Claude Code for motion generation) to produce dynamic product reels and interface animations.
* Craft kinetic typography and UI micro-interactions that communicate product capability clearly and elevate the brand presence.

### **7. Design Guidelines & Brand Identity Documentation**

* Author clear, actionable Design Guidelines and Visual Identity documentation detailing typography rules, color usage, spacing rhythm, and layout principles.
* Maintain consistent visual standards across websites, mobile apps, marketing materials, documentation, and client presentations.

### **8. Engineering Handoff & Design QA**

* Collaborate directly with frontend engineers, Odoo developers, and product leads to ensure accurate implementation.
* Conduct hands-on design QA on staging builds to identify visual bugs, contrast issues, and layout misalignments before production deployment.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

### **Must-Have**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to participate in client coordination, understand business requirements, and articulate design decisions clearly.
* Solid grasp of UI/UX design fundamentals: visual hierarchy, typography, contrast, layout grids, spacing rhythm, and responsive layout principles.
* Understanding of component-driven design systems, auto-layout paradigms, responsive states, and design tokens.
* Hands-on curiosity and practical interest in modern Generative AI image generation and visual asset creation tools.
* Ability to think through end-to-end user journeys, practical usability, and edge cases rather than just surface aesthetics.
* Eagerness to learn new AI-assisted design workflows, agentic coding tools, and technical constraints.

### **Good-to-Have (Bonus Points)**

* Experience or familiarity with **Google Stitch** (or enthusiasm to learn it rapidly).
* Familiarity or interest in motion design, video walkthroughs, or code-driven animations (e.g. GSAP, CSS animations, AI-assisted video workflows with Antigravity / Claude Code).
* Basic understanding of frontend markup (HTML, CSS/SCSS, Flexbox, Grid) and how visual designs translate into production code.
* Knowledge of mobile design guidelines (Apple Human Interface Guidelines & Google Material Design 3).

**Tools & Tech Stack You'll Explore**
-------------------------------------

* **UI/UX & Prototyping:** Google Stitch, Penpot, modern design system tooling, vector editors
* **Generative AI & Visual Media:** Modern AI image generation engines, prompt engineering suites, visual model workflows
* **Motion & Video:** AI-driven motion generation (Antigravity, Claude Code), code-driven animation tools, modern video creation suites
* **Graphics & Assets:** Vector graphic suites (SVG, Illustrator/Inkscape), iconography managers, image editors
* **Collaboration:** Notion, Slack, Git/GitHub (basic awareness)

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

* You possess strong communication skills and feel comfortable interacting with team members and clients to understand their needs.
* You obsess over details, clean alignments, and hold yourself to high aesthetic standards.
* You reject generic templates and low-effort AI slop; you care about distinctive, purposeful, and premium craft.
* You take feedback constructively, iterate rapidly, and communicate proactively.
* You thrive in an in-person studio environment where your work directly shapes shipping products.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Real Production Work:** Your designs, design systems, and video assets will go live on real enterprise products used by real businesses.
* **Modern AI Design Stack:** Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge generative AI design and agentic workflows, putting you ahead of conventional design paths.
* **Direct Mentorship & Growth:** One-on-one guidance, regular design reviews, and pairing with experienced technical and creative leaders. While a permanent job offer is not guaranteed, exceptional performers may be considered for future opportunities based on organizational needs and mutual fit.
* **Academic Credit & Certification:** Formal Appointment Letter, College NOC acceptance, Periodic Mentor Evaluations, and official Project Completion Certificate for university curriculum requirements.
* **Monthly Stipend:** To be discussed based on skills and interview performance (terms as per company internship policy).

**Internship Details**
----------------------

* **Duration:** 6 Months or 12 Months (flexible options to accommodate university semester and academic requirements).
* **Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (C-508 Dev Aurum, Prahlad Nagar).
* **Work Mode:** In-Office / On-Site (Remote/WFH is not supported).
* **Openings:** 2 Positions.
* **Eligibility:** Students in their final year (B.Des, M.Des, B.Tech, BE, BCA, MCA, or relevant design disciplines) or recent graduates and self-taught designers passionate about UI/UX and modern product design.

**How to Apply**
----------------

  

Please share your resume and any design samples, student projects, or live links you'd like us to review.
